Wisconsin couple manages 500-acre forest for wildlife, eyes $10,000 award Jesse and Kylie Sebero are managing over 500 acres of forest in Marinette County, Wisconsin. They focus on timber production while ensuring ecological balance and wildlife conservation. The couple also opens their land for educational tours, helping others learn about forest management. They have been nominated for the 2026 Wisconsin Leopold Conservation Award for their significant contributions. The award will be announced during an upcoming meeting on November 12.
